maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is commissions and fees from insurance brokerage and consulting, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed products.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are mostly private businesses and organizations buying commercial insurance and benefits consulting; payers are commercial, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Gallagher is a well-known insurance brokerage roll-up, growing through a steady stream of broker acquisitions alongside organic growth.

mission_critical.reason: Clients can change insurance brokers fairly easily, though placement and benefits programs carry some switching effort; brokerage is not strongly locked in.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgment call; broker relationships are sticky but switchable.
